title: console phone record page: two bars stacked (app bar + record top bar) and the app bar repeats the record name — where do the app menu, search, notifications and account go?
body:
domain:ui#5 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUhKx1XHzkoikGjRB4

Filing gate: ③ a follow-up the seat named in the ACCEPT of PR #28477 (#27058), item 6(a), filed after it landed. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the lane and grade.
Reach: every reader on a phone (< 768 px) on any record page.

## Observed

On `main` after #27058 (PR #28477), a phone record page draws two bars at its top: the console's `AppHeader` (sidebar trigger, app icon, the page's name, search, presence, notifications, account) and below it the record's own top bar (「‹ 线索列表」 `5 / 5` ↓ ↑). Evidence: shots `02`, `07`, `10` of PR #28477 (commit `08421f1c82`, folder `evidence/27058-phone-record-page/`).

- The board (`RecordMobile.dc.html` at `a7825499aa`, frames 2 and 3) has ONE bar on a record page: 「‹ Mira Costa ↑ ↓ ⋯」.
- `AppHeader`'s mobile label (`lastSegmentLabel`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppHeader.tsx`) is the record's name on a record route, so the name shows twice within ~150 px: in the app bar and as the header title directly below. #27058 Target 3 says the record name 「is the header title directly below and is not repeated」. The label is `main`'s behaviour from before #27058, not something PR #28477 added.

## The question (product)

PR #28477 kept `AppHeader` because on a phone it is the only door to the app menu (sidebar), search, notifications and the account menu on every route. Retiring it on record routes (to match the board) needs those four doors to live somewhere else on a phone record page, e.g. in the record top bar's `⋯`, or only on list routes. Which one is a maintainer's call.

## Wanted (after the call)

- Either: one bar on a phone record page (the board), with the four doors placed where the maintainer rules;
- or: keep two bars, and the app bar draws no record name on a record route (the object's plural or nothing), so the name is not repeated.
- Tests at 390 px beside the #27058 phone pins (`RecordDetailView.phoneFace-27058`, `AppHeader.phoneNoViewDropdown-27058`); 768 px and up unchanged.

Links back: #27058, PR #28477, #26676.
